text: ぼうそうぞくも　でて　いったし　マヨちゃんも　ぶじ　だったし　ほんと　よかったわー
note: ぼうそうぞく (bōsōzoku) are Japan's youth motorcycle gangs, known for riding noisily in groups on modified bikes; they are a familiar type of delinquent rather than just "bikers".
claim: Bōsōzoku are a Japanese youth subculture of motorcycle gangs known for riding customized, noisy motorcycles in groups.

check.quote: Bōsōzoku (暴走族, lit. 'reckless driving group') is a Japanese youth subculture associated with customized motorcycles. ... The word bōsōzoku is also applied to motorcycle subculture with an interest in motorcycle customizing, often illegal, and making noise by removing the mufflers on their vehicles so that more noise is produced. ... bōsōzoku would often embark on massed rides, in which up to 100 bikers would cruise together slowly en masse down an expressway or major highway.
